adaptations.reason: Linux has no original-preload execution; implements window.jmd IPC calls, pure basename/resolveAsset, event listeners, and an adapted Ctrl+S binding to jmd save(). IPC dispatch stays runtime/MoonBit-owned.
jmd reads nativeTheme.shouldUseDarkColors at window creation; the adapted facade returns false and exposes inert listener methods.
Bounded polling for fs.watch (250 ms), fs.watchFile/unwatchFile (250..60000 ms), and recursive fs.watch (4096-entry snapshot, change/rename event types). No native inotify claim.
jmd can open a path through loadFile options.query; values are encoded deterministically and the app scheme accepts a query.
ELECTRON_MBT_TEST_MESSAGE_BOX=0..2 returns a deterministic response. Without it showMessageBox stays typed unsupported; there is no destructive default.

Linux host get-primary-display/get-all-displays use GDK monitor geometry; prelude getAllDisplays/getDisplayNearestPoint/getDisplayMatching select by containment/intersection with a documented fallback.
CLI-only test:menu-save hook sends the same menu:save topic the native Save item sends; the native menu remains store-only.
The native application menu is store-only in the adapted profile, so Ctrl+S is bound in the adapted page to jmd's own save(). This is not native menu installation.

note: Pinned jmd 0.2.3 boots the real renderer, opens a markdown document through the test-injected native dialog, edits via the host hook and via real X11/xdotool input, saves via Ctrl+S through the adapted page shortcut, reloads after an external rewrite through the polling watcher, and reads GDK display geometry. The native menu remains store-only. compatible:false; IME and macOS are NOT_RUN/out of scope.

protocol.note: The adapted stage admits jmd-file; the broker serves the document-directory PNG. protocol.handle is recorded, not executed.
